import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyBilinear

/-!
# Character cups as bilinear group cocycles

The character cup cocycle is the special case of the bilinear cocycle
constructor obtained from the pointwise product of two characters.  This
bridge lets later finite-free decompositions use the bilinear class API while
retaining the source-facing cup notation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U]

/-- The bilinear map whose value is the product of two integral characters. -/
def groupCharacterBilinear (f g : U →+ ℤ) : U →+ U →+ ℤ where
  toFun u :=
    { toFun := fun v => f u * g v
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := by intro v w; simp [mul_add] }
  map_zero' := by ext v; simp
  map_add' u v := by
    ext w
    simp [add_mul]

@[simp]
theorem groupCharacterBilinear_apply (f g : U →+ ℤ) (u v : U) :
    groupCharacterBilinear f g u v = f u * g v := rfl

/-- The bilinear cocycle of two characters is their usual cup cocycle. -/
theorem groupBilinearCocycle_groupCharacterBilinear (f g : U →+ ℤ) :
    groupBilinearCocycle (groupCharacterBilinear f g) =
      groupCharacterCupCocycle f g := by
  ext p
  rfl

/-- The bilinear class of two characters is their group-cohomology cup class. -/
theorem groupBilinearClass_groupCharacterBilinear (f g : U →+ ℤ) :
    groupBilinearClass (groupCharacterBilinear f g) =
      groupCharacterCupClass f g := by
  change groupCohomology.H2π _ (groupBilinearCocycle (groupCharacterBilinear f g)) =
    groupCohomology.H2π _ (groupCharacterCupCocycle f g)
  rw [groupBilinearCocycle_groupCharacterBilinear]

end Mumford.Analytic
